subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should delegated cross-channel Mattermost reads be enabled through an action-scoped plugin authorization contract, rather than placing Mattermost in the channel-wide core provider-read-gate allowlist?
rationale: The current implementation broadens delegated authorization for existing Mattermost reactions, while the repository policy favors plugin-owned behavior through generic seams; choosing the permanent contract is a maintainer boundary decision.

options.title: Add an action-scoped authorization seam
options.body: Keep host exact-current protection for Mattermost reactions and let the Mattermost plugin authorize only delegated `read` requests.

options.title: Accept channel-wide delegated gating
options.body: Retain the current allowlist and explicitly extend Mattermost-side authorization to every affected read-dependent action, including reactions.

recommendation.title: Add an action-scoped authorization seam
recommendation.body: Keep host exact-current protection for Mattermost reactions and let the Mattermost plugin authorize only delegated `read` requests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent merged provider-read work makes them the strongest available routing candidate for the shared dispatch contract.
